title: The 4 Best Space Heaters for Large Rooms
h1: The 4 Best Space Heaters for Large Rooms
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for space heaters for large rooms, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at space heaters for large rooms using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Dreo Solaris 317 Space Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500W PTC ceramic heating element, 70-degree oscillation, 34dB whisper-quiet brushless DC motor.
strengths: 70-degree oscillation spreads heat across a noticeably wider arc than fixed heaters
34dB fan noise is quiet enough to run in an occupied living room without being distracting
1°F thermostat steps hold a target temperature more precisely than dial-based competitors
Digital display and remote make adjusting settings from across a large room easy
limitations: Still capped at 1500W like every other model here, so raw output is the same
Plastic housing feels lighter-duty than the De'Longhi's metal radiator body
Priced higher than basic tower heaters without oscillation

products.name: De'Longhi Dragon Digital Oil-Filled Radiator TRD40615EBK
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500W oil-filled radiator with 75% more radiant surface area, Digital display with programmable timer, ECO energy-saving mode.
strengths: Fanless design circulates no dust or allergens through a large living space
Residual heat keeps a large room from cooling immediately after shutoff
ECO mode measurably cuts running cost over a multi-hour evening
Even, gentle heat suits rooms occupied for long stretches
limitations: Slowest to reach target temperature of any model in this list
Bulkiest and heaviest option, harder to reposition around furniture
Surface gets hot enough to touch that it needs clearance from foot traffic
features: 1500W oil-filled radiator with 75% more radiant surface area

products.name: Lasko 5572 Oscillating Ceramic Tower Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 29-inch oscillating tower, Logic Center digital remote, Adjustable thermostat.
strengths: 29-inch tower height circulates warm air across a taller vertical spread
Digital remote and timer at a price well under the Dreo or De'Longhi
Long production history gives it the largest ratings count in this list
Widespread oscillation covers more of a large room than compact models
limitations: Only 2 fixed heat settings instead of a stepless dial
Plastic tower body feels lighter-duty than the metal De'Longhi radiator
Noticeable fan noise on the high setting

products.name: Vornado VH202 Personal Space Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: Vortex heat circulation fan, 2 heat settings plus fan-only mode, Cool-touch exterior.
strengths: Vortex airflow circulates warm air across a seating area rather than a single hot spot
Cool-touch housing is safe for a heater sitting close to a couch or chair
Small enough to move between rooms as a supplemental unit
limitations: No oscillation, so it can't cover a large room on its own
Not rated as a primary heater for a large open floor plan

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
